I have not actually used it yet so I'm describing what I see. This fruit press is heavy and solid. I've assembled it and it operates as described. There's enamel coating everywhere on the press. The basket appears to be good quality stainless that looks like it'll last for many years. The press plate is reinforced, solid and heavy. I originally wanted a wooden basket style press but I am so glad I bought the stainless steel style. This unit will be easy to clean and sanitize. My only complaint was that it too long to get to me (a week) and I had to manually press my grapes. I can't wait for my first grape pressing next year!
The fixation is very secure, no shifting even with heavy contact. The stability is totally reassuring.

In today's climate, having a modest supply of water on hand is ever more important, and the ways to store them within a small area are few. At first glance the system appeared less than formidable, but after careful assembly it turned out to be a nice solid unit that fits well next to the chest freezer. We presently have 6 bottles on ours and it is as sturdy as I could wish for. Very good bang for the buck:-)
sturdy and holds 8 full bottles with no problems. Keeps them neat and tidy and doesnt take up much space. Easy to assemble.Recommend
